body: ## Verifier verdict: **pass** This work item's spec carries no `acceptance_checks` (gardening pipeline, `spec: null`), so I verified the change against the claim it makes for itself — *"adds a test runner and 52 tests over all five files in src/, and changes no behaviour"* — and against the runbook's **Verify** section, by starting the app (`node src/server.js`, env from `.factory/sandbox/.runtime.env`) and using it. ### Checks | \# | Check | Result | | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | `src/` is untouched, so no behaviour can have changed | **pass** — `git diff HEAD -- src/` is empty; the commit touches only `package.json` (+1 line) and the six new files in `tests/` | | 2 | The declared runner actually runs | **pass** — `npm test` → **52 pass, 0 fail**, exit 0 | | 3 | ...repeatably, and not by luck of the environment | **pass** — 3 consecutive runs 52/52; also 52/52 under the closed env (`PATH HOME TMPDIR LANG CI PORT` only), and 52/52 *while the app held PORT 3000* (the suite binds port 0, so it does not collide) | | 4 | The tests can fail | **pass** — see mutation table below | | 5 | The running app behaves the way the tests say it does | **pass** — every assertion cross-checked against the live app, below | | 6 | Nothing else regressed | **pass** — `npm run lint` exit 0; tests leave no stray process and nothing listening; repo not dirtied by a test run | ### The running app, against each test claim Browser (Chromium via Playwright) and curl, against \`(127.0.0.1/redacted) - **`GET /` empty state** — heading *Stock*, bordered table with the `id name qty price` header row, `total: $0.00`, the three-field add form, *export csv* link. Only console message is the documented `404 /favicon.ico`. → `01-index-empty.png` - **Add through the form** — filled `Bolt` / `5` / `275`, clicked **add**: redirected to `/` with row `1 | Bolt | 5 | $2.75` and `total: $13.75` — qty × price, not price, exactly as the runbook states. → `02-after-add-bolt.png` - **Delete link** — row and its value gone, total back to `$0.00`. → `03-after-delete.png` - **Totals match the test fixtures** — Widget(3,1250)+Gasket(12,499) → `total: $97.38` (test line 53); after deleting Widget → `total: $59.88` (test line 127). - **CSV** — body byte-identical to what `handlers.test.js:156` asserts (`id,name,qty,price\n2,Widget,3,12.50\n3,Gasket,12,4.99\n`), with `Content-Type: text/csv; charset=utf-8` and `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="stock.csv"`; no `$` anywhere; empty store is the header row alone. → `curl-02-export-empty.txt` - **Escaping** — a name of `&` renders as `&` and the browser shows it as literal text, not bold. → `04-escaped-name.png` - **The two 400s and the two leniencies** — missing name and empty name both `400 name required` with nothing stored; `qty=lots` → `1`; `price=cheap` → `0`; name alone → qty `1`, price `0.00`; `/delete` with no id → `400 id required`; unknown id → `302`, nothing changed. `GET /add` and `/nope` → `404`. - **Seed command + `/report`** — `lines: 3`, `units: 16`, `value: $297.37`, and `/` shows the same `$297.37`, so `report.totals` and `util.total` agree. → `05-index-seeded.png`, `06-report-seeded.png` - **Ways it could look right but be wrong** — second click on an already-used delete link: `302`, total unchanged at `$237.49`, no stray row (`07`, `08`). Restart: store empties and ids restart at 1, as documented. ### Mutation check — none of these is a test that cannot fail I broke each file in `src/` in turn and confirmed the suite caught it, restoring `src/` to HEAD after each (final `git diff HEAD -- src/` is empty): | Mutation | Tests failed | | --- | --- | | `util.total` sums price instead of qty × price | 5 | | `db.find`/`db.remove` use strict `===`/`!==` | 4 | | `handlers`: bad qty falls back to 0 not 1 | 2 | | `handlers`: `util.esc` dropped from the name cell | 1 | | `handlers`: csv uses `money` instead of `money2` | 2 | | `handlers`: `Content-Disposition` header removed | 1 | | `report`: units counts lines instead of qty | 2 | | `server`: `/health` route unwired | 3 | | `server`: `require.main` guard removed | 4 | All five files in `src/` are covered by at least one failing mutation. ### Coverage `node --test --experimental-test-coverage`: `db.js`, `handlers.js`, `report.js`, `util.js` at **100%** line/branch/function; `server.js` at **82.61%** lines, uncovered `18-21` — the `app.listen` callback. That callback *is* exercised, by `server.test.js`'s child-process test that waits for `listening on (port)` and then fetches `/health`; the reporter simply cannot attribute coverage across a process boundary. Comfortably over the `diff_min_pct: 80` guardrail. ### One gap, reported separately — not a failed check `commands.test` in the frozen `.factory/sandbox/manifest.json` is still `null`, and its `capabilities.not_exercised` entry *"Automated tests and total coverage"* is now out of date. The suite runs fine here — I ran it by hand — but **the tests gate will not run it**, and total coverage stays pinned at the `0` floor in `.factory/guardrails/coverage.json`, until the manifest is amended to `"test": "npm test"`. The PR description already flags this. I have written `/tmp/gh-aw/agent/bsf/sandbox-report.json` so the sandbox gets amended. This does not hold up the change: the acceptance here is that the tests exist, run, pass, pin real behaviour, and leave the app alone — all five verified above against the running app. ### Evidence `/tmp/gh-aw/agent/bsf/media/` — `01-index-empty.png`, `02-after-add-bolt.png`, `03-after-delete.png`, `04-escaped-name.png`, `05-index-seeded.png`, `06-report-seeded.png`, `07-stale-delete-second-click.png`, `08-after-delete-gasket.png`, `npm-test-output.txt`, `curl-01-index-empty.html`, `curl-02-export-empty.txt`, `server.log`, `server-restart.log`. > Generated by [Verifier](https://github.com/bsf-fixtures/js-legacy/actions/runs/44882649747) for #11 · claude · opus50 · \~118 AIC · ⌖ \~23 AIC · ⊞ 2.6K · [◷](https://github.com/search?q=repo%3Absf-fixtures%2Fjs-legacy+%22gh-aw-workflow-call-id%3A+bsf-fixtures%2Fjs-legacy%2Ffactory-role-verifier%22&type=issues)
